import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Plot a barplot to show the distribution of transaction types by fraud status
sns.countplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Save the plot as a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
